subject: Post-demo: inference cost bakeoff & $/1M target
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Post-demo recap — cost posture + next steps

Hi Jenna — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and a proposed plan so we can align on the pricing/volume conversation with Procurement: 

Key points I captured from the call:
- Expected steady-state inference volume: ~150M tokens / month, spiking to ~300M in seasonal months (Q4).
- Primary workload: multi-turn clinical summarization + internal search embeddings (mix ~70/30 tokens generation:embedding).
- Current vendor baseline: ClearPath is budgeting ~$12k–$35k/month for inference depending on model & SLA.
- Target: Aaron asked for a target unit price to model at 1M-token granularity for the finance runbook.

Immediate asks / suggested next steps:
1) Can you confirm the 150M baseline and the expected 3x spike months? I want to lock the volume bands we use for the comparison.
2) I attached a short workbook (clearpath_econ_workup_v1.xlsx) with two simple scenarios — please flag if we missed anything.
3) Once volumes are confirmed, we’ll send a short comparator that shows projected monthly spend at candidate $/1M targets versus OpenAI/Anthropic/hosted open-model providers so Procurement has a tangible run-rate table.

Indicative benchmarking (for internal alignment only) — rough order of magnitude per 1M tokens:
- OpenAI (current chat-oriented SKU): ~ $28 / 1M tokens (indicative)
- Anthropic (chat SKU): ~ $35 / 1M tokens (indicative)
- Self-hosted / other open-model hosts (quantized, bulk commit): ~$6–$12 / 1M tokens (wide spread depending on instance mix and infra)

Those are indicative; final numbers depend on model selection (encoder-only vs. large decoder), quantization, and batching. If ClearPath is modeling a target in the $8–$15 / 1M range, we can lay out a Dedicated/private deployment proposal and show the unit economics including committed capacity discounts and caching benefits.

Please let me know the confirmed volume bands and if Aaron prefers the short table as a slide or CSV for Procurement.

Thanks —
David Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0124

---
Attachment: clearpath_econ_workup_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB)

From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@clearpathhealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aaron Fields <aaron.fields@clearpathhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — cost posture + next steps

David — thanks for the concise recap. Confirming the volumes: baseline 150M tokens/month, Q4 spikes up to ~350M for two months. The mix you captured is right.

A few clarifications from our side before Aaron runs this through Procurement:
- The 150M baseline assumes 50% of queries will be served by the smaller summarization model (lower-cost), the other 50% by the larger longform model. Can you show the split economics?
- We will need a conservative estimate for cache hit improvements — Procurement likes to see both raw token costs and expected effective token costs after caching.
- Placeholder target from our CFO: they want to model scenarios at $10, $15, and $25 per 1M tokens. Can you map Redwood’s proposals to those targets?

If you can return a one-page summary + CSV by EOD Tuesday that maps monthly run-rates across those three targets against OpenAI and Anthropic, that will be perfect.

Best,
Jenna
Head of Product Analytics | ClearPath Health
jenna.park@clearpathhealth.com

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@clearpathhealth.com>, Aaron Fields <aaron.fields@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 09:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — cost posture + next steps

Jenna/Aaron — attaching the one-page comparator and the CSV export (redwood-1m-comparator-summary.pdf + clearpath_econ_workup_v1.xlsx). See the short summary below; full detail in the sheet.

Executive summary (attached PDF page 1):
- We modeled three $/1M targets (10, 15, 25) across your baseline (150M) and spike (350M) months.
- For each target, we show: gross monthly spend at that explicit $/1M, plus an "effective" spend line that assumes a conservative 20% cache/KV-hit improvement for summarization flows and a 10% improvement for embeddings.

Comparator snapshot (all figures per 1M tokens, indicative):
- OpenAI (chat SKU): $28 / 1M
- Anthropic (chat): $34 / 1M
- Redwood hosted (open-model, committed Dedicated pricing with quantization & batching): we can hit ~$9 / 1M at 3–6 month commit bands for your baseline profile (150M); with a 12–18 month commit we have deeper anchors below $8 / 1M on average.
- Self-managed (customer-managed infra) estimates: $4–$10 / 1M depending on instance utilization and ops overhead.

Why Redwood can move the needle for ClearPath:
- Prefix/KV caching on summarization models meaningfully reduces effective generation tokens for repeat clinical flows.
- Routing & model mix: we can route 60% of summary calls to smaller quantized variants with comparable quality for many workflows.
- Committed bandwidth + batching reduces per-token CPU/GPU overhead compared with on-demand hosts.

Requested confirmations for final pricing packet:
- Confirm the expected percentage of calls that can be served by smaller model (you mentioned ~50% in your note).
- Confirm the spike month definition: is Q4 a single intensive 2-month window or spread across Q4?

Next steps:
1) If you confirm, we’ll generate a formal commercial grid showing monthly invoices under three commitment tiers and an SOW template for Dedicated capacity.
2) If Procurement wants to try a Pilot, we can propose a 3-month reduced-commit pilot that guarantees throughput and shows realized effective $/1M after caching.

Thanks — attaching files now.

—
David Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-1m-comparator-summary.pdf (1 page), clearpath_econ_workup_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB)

From: Procurement <procurement@clearpathhealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Jenna Park <jenna.park@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Aaron Fields <aaron.fields@clearpathhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — cost posture + next steps

David — thanks for the fast turnaround and the attachments. We’ll run the three target scenarios through the cost model this afternoon and revert with any questions. Two quick notes for your commercial grid: please include
- A one-line SLA summary for Dedicated vs Hosted (latency SLO, uptime %, and credit policy)
- An explicit list of any pass-through infra charges (if Redwood Dedicated has any cloud egress or region surcharges)

If you can include those in the formal grid, Procurement will be able to compare apples-to-apples. Expect a follow-up by EOD Thursday.

Procurement | ClearPath Health
procurement@clearpathhealth.com
